scam_info.sample: Customer Service: +65 6321 8888 Whatsapp Business Account: +65 3129 5222* ... Email: clientservice@sg.moomoo.com SMS SenderID: moomoo or moomooSG
scam_info.notes: 'Scam Alert: Statement from Moomoo Singapore' (publishTime 2026-08-24 in page JSON; displayed 'Aug 24 15:38'). Lists genuine contact channels; 'Our official website is www.moomoo.com/sg'; 'We do not use any other numbers to contact clients'; no advice via WhatsApp/Telegram/RCS/WeChat; account opening only via moomoo.com/sg/support, no third-party agents. Narrative description of fake sites/apps, fake 'high-risk verification', chat-group impersonation; no concrete fake indicators. URL linked from SG homepage as /sg/learn/detail-scam-alert-from-moomoo-singapore-117972-250689010 (redirects here). Also in zh-Hans/zh-Hant (/sg/hans/..., /sg/hant/...).

scam_info.sample: If the sender's email address does NOT end with @sg.moomoo.com , it is a scam.
scam_info.notes: 'Security Alert: Beware of Phishing Scams' (publishTime 2026-07-09). 'email' = official sender domain @sg.moomoo.com (official); phishing example shown only as an image. CS hotline +65-6321 8888.
